verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Klaviyo has drag-and-drop email editors and basic email templates (docs-11, docs-19, docs-27), plus AI-assisted content creation (docs-25, docs-37). However, there is no evidence of personalization tokens, cross-client rendering guarantees, or reusable/on-brand template management features being documented. Missing for 10: personalization token documentation, cross-email-client rendering testing/guarantees, reusable brand template library details, independent hands-on validation of editor quality.
